card.name: Space or digit just before a number
card.fires_on: The space, decimal point or first digit right before a number, such as a dose, a count of people or a year. It is strongest where a quantity or date is about to be written.

modes.label: Space before a dose
modes.description: A blank space after a drug name or 'and' just before a strength in mg.
modes.example: One VIREAD<< >>300 mg tablet once daily taken

modes.label: Space before a count or year
modes.description: A blank space before a number of people, hours, years or a law year.
modes.example: The number is 0808 800 5000 and it's open<< >>24 hours a day.

modes.label: Digit or point inside a number
modes.description: A decimal point or first digit that begins a strength like 400 mg.

card.writes: The promoted Chinese words ('inside', 'put it in') do not fit the English text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the gap or first digit just before a number such as a dose, a count or a year.
